text:
**Short answer:** For most iPhone owners, the **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount** is the best pick. If you want the fastest charging and can supply a high-wattage car adapter, get the **Anker Prime**. If you want a fan-cooled mount for less, get the **ESR HaloLock with CryoBoost**.

| Mount | Best for | Charging | Price (as reported) | Key caveat |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 Vent Mount** | Most iPhone drivers | Qi2, up to 15W | $47.99 | Needs straight horizontal vent slats (≤3 mm thick, ≤20 mm deep). Includes a 27W adapter. [1][2][3] |
| **Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933)** | Fastest charging | Qi2 25W, with fan and thermoelectric cooling | $89.99 | Needs a 45W+ USB-C car adapter for 25W. Not compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz, or cars without vent blades. Phone-specific limits apply. [2][3] |
| **ESR HaloLock with CryoBoost** | Value with active cooling | Qi2, 15W, with fan | Varies by source (see below) | The 18W car adapter isn't included. Vent or dashboard mounting, depending on package. [1][4] |

**Notes**

- **Belkin:** Vertical or shallow vent slats can shift or droop under the phone's weight, so check your vents before buying. [2][3]
- **Anker:** Its cooling helps on hot days and during navigation. Under a 25W rating, an iPhone 17 gets up to 25W, but an iPhone 16 gets up to 22W and an iPhone Air up to 20W. [2][3]
- **ESR:** Prices conflict between sources. Dealectric reports $39.99 at ESR's US store, or $32.80 with code PARTNER18 (tested 2026-10-22, expires 2026-12-31) [1]. Gadgeteer lists $18.99 [4]. Confirm the price at checkout.
- **Budget option:** The LISEN and ESR 15W mounts are cheaper, at roughly $16–$27, but their guides don't rate them as highly. [2][3][4]

**Where to buy**

- ESR HaloLock CryoBoost: [ESR's US store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). Dealectric earns a commission on purchases through this link. [1]
- Belkin BoostCharge: [search Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Belkin+BoostCharge+Magnetic+Wireless+Car+Vent+Mount+Qi2). The guides list it on Amazon, but the search results didn't include a direct product URL. [2][3]
- Anker Prime MagGo AirCool: [search Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Anker+Prime+MagGo+AirCool+Qi2+25W+car+mount). The guides list it on Amazon, but the search results didn't include a direct product URL. [2][3]
